messages:
rita: Quick thread: TS/Go/py SDKs currently treat route metadata header differently. proposing 'X-Route-Meta' as the single canonical header and adding SDK-level helpers to parse it into a typed map.
omar: Will this affect existing console dashboards that parse route metadata into tags?
rita: ingestion will normalize to `route_meta` and expose parsed tags in the UI. We'll also keep the raw header available in logs for 30 days.
li: telemetry pipeline needs to know keys we expect. i'll add a schema entry for `route_meta` -> object of string key/values. keep in mind our event schema doesn't support nested objects currently.
sasha: If schema doesn't support nested objects, can SDKs emit a flattened string `k1=v1;k2=v2` and ingestion parse it? that's less breaking.
rita: yeah, forced to do that to avoid schema bump. SDKs: please emit `X-Route-Meta: k=v;k2=v2` style. we'll parse on ingestion. add unit tests for encoding/decoding.
devex-bot: reminder: add examples to SDK READMEs and a migration note.
ops-bot: canary up at 2024-06-05 12:00Z.
